mapper.insert: insert into memory_fragment ( id, tenant_id, app_id, user_id, timeline_root, content_text, searchable, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{appId}, #{userId}, #{timelineRoot}, #{contentText}, #{searchable}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: select id, tenant_id, app_id, user_id, timeline_root, content_text, searchable, deleted, created_at from memory_fragment where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and app_id = #{appId} and user_id = #{userId} and id = #{id} and deleted = false limit 1

select id, tenant_id, app_id, user_id, timeline_root, content_text, searchable, deleted, created_at from memory_fragment where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and app_id = #{appId} and user_id = #{userId} and deleted = false and searchable = true order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}
